item.description: The scheme will run in three phases. The first phase will run from December 1st to December 31st. Consumers who register under this scheme will receive a 100 percent interest waiver on their bills, along with a 25 percent principal discount.

item.title: Nitish Kumar to take oath as Bihar CM for 10th time today; Old faces likely to dominate Cabinet | Dynamite News
item.description: Bihar is set to witness a major political event as Nitish Kumar takes oath as Chief Minister for the 10th time. Following his unanimous election as NDA Legislature Party leader, he resigned and staked claim to form a new government again with NDA partners. BJP leaders Samrat Choudhary and Vijay Kumar Sinha are likely to become Deputy CMs, while allies like LJP(R), RLSP, and HAM may get new ministerial berths.

item.title: No rain likely in Delhi-NCR today as pollution peaks to dangerous levels | Dynamite News
item.description: Delhi-NCR is facing a sharp winter chill with a cold-wave alert, hazardous air quality, and thick morning fog–but no rain in sight today. The IMD warns of dropping temperatures in Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, and Gurugram, while AQI levels have surged into the “severe” category.

item.title: Gold prices surge across cities; Silver jumps to fresh high | Dynamite News
item.description: Gold prices surged on 20 November across major Indian cities, with 24-carat gold touching ₹1,25,020 per 10 grams in Delhi. Other metros like Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata also recorded a rise, with prices hovering near ₹1,24,870.

item.title: India secures 100 Javelin Missiles as US approves powerful defence package; Details inside | Dynamite News
item.description: The United States has approved a major $93 million arms deal to sell 100 FGM-148 Javelin anti-tank missiles, 25 lightweight launch units, and 216 Excalibur precision-guided artillery rounds to India. The package includes full lifecycle support, training, and technical assistance.
